tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have the experience of minimum 5 years as on the date of publication of the tender in organizing trade exhibition/trade show/ consumer exhibitions for any State/ Central Government Departments or Government organizations, International Exhibition, Mega Cultural Event, Government Convention, Industrial Expo, public Event more than 27000 visitors.

Should have successfully completed any one of the following during the last 5 years Option A Three similar Event Management projects each valued at not less than 2.50 crore Or Option B Two similar projects each valued at not less than Rs.4.00 crore Or Option C One similar project valued at not less than 7.00 crore Similar Projects Means Govt. Exhibition State Festival Trade Fair International Exhibition Mega Cultural Event Government Convention Industrial Expo Buyer Seller Meet Public Event with more than 15,000 visitors

The bidder Service Provider should not have been debarred blacklisted by any State Government, Central Government, Central & State Govt. Undertakings enterprises Organizations and by any other Quasi Government bodies Organizations, World Bank Govt E marketing portal or any major Enterprise Organization in India for non satisfactory performance, corrupt & Fraudulent or any other unethical business practices, not meeting critical conditions/security clearance etc., during the past.
